questions.code:
numbers = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]
target = 1
left = 0
right = len(numbers) - 1
checks = 0
while left <= right:
    mid = (left + right) // 2
    checks += 1
    if numbers[mid] == target:
        break
    elif numbers[mid] < target:
        left = mid + 1
    else:
        right = mid - 1
print(checks)
